decisions.reason: The portfolio quantity is an independent clause already represented by the candidate's message 19 MODIFY; changing the brochure count does not otherwise alter the portfolio requirement.
Message 19 does not change the business pitch content; its content reference specifically concerns separate social-media deliverables.
The social-media deliverable is established independently by its own clause and is already represented by the candidate's message 19 INTRODUCE; the brochure count change does not alter it.
